mapper.sql: id, operation, arguments_json, baseline_json, scope_key, pending_scope, status, display_name, applicant_account_id, execution_message
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM sr_tutorial_category ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sr_tutorial_operation (operation, arguments_json, baseline_json, scope_key, pending_scope, status, display_name, applicant_account_id) VALUES (#{operation}, #{argumentsJson}, #{baselineJson}, #{scopeKey}, #{pendingScope}, #{status}, #{displayName}, #{applicantAccountId})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sr_tutorial_operation WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, scope_key, operation, display_name FROM sr_tutorial_operation WHERE status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE sr_tutorial_operation SET status = #{status}, pending_scope = NULL, execution_message = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND (status = 'PENDING' OR (status = 'FAILED' AND #{status} = 'APPLIED'))
UPDATE sr_tutorial_operation SET status = 'FAILED', pending_scope = NULL, execution_message = #{message} WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED')
